grammar.title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响或持续到现在的经历；一般过去时仅陈述过去发生的事实，与现在无关。
grammar.structure: have/has + 过去分词 vs 动词过去式

examples.sentence: I have lived in London for five years.
examples.translation: 我在伦敦住了五年了。（现在仍住在伦敦）

examples.sentence: I lived in London for five years.
examples.translation: 我在伦敦住过五年。（现在已不住那里）

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思写作Task 1描述数据变化时，描述至今为止的变化用现在完成时；描述过去某时间点的数据用一般过去时。

speaking.topic: Describe a person who has influenced you
speaking.cueCard: Describe a person who has had a significant influence on your life. You should say: who this person is / how you know them / what they are like / and explain why they have influenced you so much.
speaking.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about my high school English teacher, Ms. Chen, who has profoundly shaped the person I am today. I first met her when I was fifteen, struggling with self-confidence after a string of poor grades. What struck me about Ms. Chen was her unwavering belief in every student's potential—she never gave up on anyone, no matter how poorly they performed. Rather than simply teaching grammar and vocabulary, she encouraged us to think critically and express ourselves fearlessly. I vividly remember her telling me, 'Mistakes are proof that you're trying.' That single sentence transformed my attitude towards learning. Thanks to her guidance, I not only improved my English but also developed the resilience to face challenges head-on. Even now, years after graduation, her words continue to inspire me whenever I encounter difficulties.
speaking.tips: Part 2 要讲满 1-2 分钟，注意细节描写让故事生动。
